messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — Acme is seeing intermittent 401s during SDK init (node). They started onboarding today and hit a burst. Anyone from eng able to help?
ben: I'll take it. Can you share the SDK version + sample logs?
maria: Pasted below from the customer.
carol: @maria sharing the log we captured:
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
x-request-id: abc123
{"error":"invalid_client"}
```
We're using redwood-js-sdk 0.6.2 and issuing ephemeral tokens via our auth proxy.
ben: OK, `invalid_client` usually means token scope/validity problem or token used after expiry. Are they using very short TTLs or high preflight concurrency?
carol: We set ephemeral TTL to 30s. Also during deploy we saw a lot of parallel preflight calls ~300 concurrent.
ben: That would explain a race: preflight fanout + short TTL -> token can't be used when the request hits the gateway. Two immediate checks: 1) confirm the auth proxy system clock isn't skewed, 2) try increasing TTL to 120s for onboarding and see if it stabilizes.
maria: Also worth checking if rate limiting is returning 429s earlier which then cascades into auth failures in the client.
dave: I pulled the ingress logs for tenant acme, x-request-id abc123 — saw a cluster of 429s at 15:32:10 UTC, immediately followed by a flurry of 401s for the same session window. Looks like concurrent preflight created backpressure.
ben: Got it. Two short-term mitigations: 1) we can temporarily relax rate limits for the tenant for a 10m onboarding window; 2) advise the customer to debounce/coalesce preflight and add jitter/backoff. Longer term: add SDK preflight debounce by default.
carol: We'll try TTL=120s + client-side debounce (200ms). Any server-side workarounds we should do now?
maria: I can enable an onboarding rate-limit exemption for 10 minutes unless you prefer to test first.
carol: Please enable it — that'll help validate the TTL change faster. Thanks.
ben: I'll prepare a small docs patch recommending 1) ephemeral TTL >= 120s during onboarding, 2) client preflight debounce + jitter, and a sample snippet for Node.
dave: Exemption applied for tenant acme for 10m. Monitoring logs now.
maria: Great — keep me posted. Thanks team :pray:
